title: Terms of Service
summary: You must be 18 or over to use the app.
You are responsible for what you post. Be respectful.
We are only a tool. Meet in public places when you go out for drinks.
Drinking-game penalties are always voluntary. Never pressure anyone, and never drive after drinking.
You can report, block, or delete your account at any time from your profile panel.

sections.title: About the service
paragraphs: hi drink (the "Service") is provided by the hi drink development team ("we"). It includes the map, check-ins, friends, chat, drinking meetups and games. By using the Service you accept these Terms.

sections.title: Eligibility: 18 or over
paragraphs: You must be 18 or over. Hong Kong law prohibits the sale or supply of liquor to people under 18 in the course of business, and we only allow adults to use the Service. If we find that you are under 18 we may suspend or delete your account.

sections.title: Your content and community rules
paragraphs: You keep ownership of your photos, text and voice, and you allow us to store, display and transmit them to run the Service. Please do not post:
bullets: Illegal, sexual, violent, harassing or discriminatory content
Other people's private information, or photos taken without their consent
Content that encourages excessive drinking or supplies alcohol to minors

sections.title: Meetups and personal safety
paragraphs: We only provide matching and chat tools. We are not the host of any meetup. Meet in public places, tell a friend, and judge the risks yourself.

sections.title: Drinking games and responsibility
paragraphs: Drinking penalties in games are entirely voluntary and can always be swapped for another challenge. Never force anyone to drink. Do not drive after drinking.

sections.title: Location and who can see you
paragraphs: In Settings you can choose public, friends only, or invisible. See the Privacy Policy for details.

sections.title: Reports, complaints and how we handle them
paragraphs: You can report a user or content, report inside a game room, or file a complaint about attendance or behaviour at a meetup. You can also block someone. Complaints are first classified automatically and then handled by our reviewers. The person complained about can respond, and both sides can appeal after the result. Safety cases are handled first. We may remove content, restrict features or suspend accounts.

sections.title: AI bartender Ivy
paragraphs: Ivy is an AI character, not a real person. Her replies are generated automatically by a third-party AI service (MiniMax) and can be wrong or unsuitable. Do not rely on Ivy for medical, legal or safety advice, and do not share other people's private information with her. You can report any Ivy reply inside the app.

sections.title: Child safety
paragraphs: We have zero tolerance for content that sexualises, exploits or endangers anyone under 18, and for anyone who tries to contact minors. This is banned and leads to permanent removal. You can report content or a user from inside the app. We review reports, remove content and accounts, and report confirmed child sexual abuse material to the competent authorities. Our full child safety standards: https://www.whattodrink.app/en/legal/child-safety

sections.title: Ending your account
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time by tapping “Delete account” at the bottom of your profile panel (tap your avatar on the home screen).

sections.title: Governing law and contact
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Contact: support@whattodrink.app.
